about_the_game:
Enhance your style with the Founder's Edition and support the developers by doing so! Whether you're watering your crops or haggling over high-end potions, why not look fabulous doing it?

As a token of appreciation you will receive:

  • 2 brand new, exclusive player outfits, giving you the upper hand in fancy fashion.

  • Each outfit includes 8 color variations, so you can tailor (pun intended) your look to match your shop's vibe, or your mood!

  • The satisfaction of supporting the dev team <3

Dress for success and show off your personal flair while running the coziest shop in the realm!
